parameters.query:
WITH wrapper AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS w
),
payload AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode(w->>'b64', 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS p
  FROM wrapper
),
required_columns(table_name, column_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'current_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'repository_full_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'current_phase'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'target_branch_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'error_message'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'locked_by'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'worker_execution_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'claim_token'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'lock_expires_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'last_heartbeat_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'updated_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'event_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'previous_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'new_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'event_type'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'event_payload_json'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'created_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'step_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'input_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'output_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'started_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'completed_at')
),
missing_columns AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_name', rc.table_name, 'column_name', rc.column_name) ORDER BY rc.table_name, rc.column_name),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS missing
  FROM required_columns rc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns c
    WHERE c.table_schema = current_schema()
      AND c.table_name = rc.table_name
      AND c.column_name = rc.column_name
  )
),
run_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    r.workflow_run_id,
    r.current_state,
    r.status,
    r.repository_full_name
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  JOIN payload p ON r.workflow_run_id = p->>'workflow_run_id'
  LIMIT 1
),
decision AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    missing,
    to_jsonb(run_lookup) AS run_json,
    COALESCE((p->>'github_request_valid')::boolean, false) AS request_valid,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE((p->>'github_request_valid')::boolean, false) = false THEN 400
      WHEN jsonb_array_length(missing) > 0 THEN 400
      WHEN run_lookup.workflow_run_id IS NULL THEN 404
      WHEN run_lookup.repository_full_name <> p->>'repository_full_name' THEN 400
      WHEN COALESCE(run_lookup.current_state, '') NOT IN ('ready_for_review', 'pm_l3_package_drafted', 'github_execution_retry_wait') THEN 409
      ELSE 200
    END AS http_status_code
  FROM payload
  CROSS JOIN missing_columns
  LEFT JOIN run_lookup ON true
),
response_errors AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    missing,
    run_json,
    request_valid,
    http_status_code,
    CASE
      WHEN request_valid = false THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb)
      WHEN jsonb_array_length(missing) > 0 THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'postgres_schema_missing_expected_columns', 'field', 'postgres_schema', 'message', 'expected columns are missing', 'missing_columns', missing))
      WHEN run_json IS NULL THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'workflow_run_not_found', 'field', 'workflow_run_id', 'message', 'workflow_run_id does not exist'))
      WHEN (run_json->>'repository_full_name') <> p->>'repository_full_name' THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'repository_full_name_mismatch', 'field', 'repository_full_name', 'message', 'workflow_run repository does not match request repository'))
      WHEN COALESCE(run_json->>'current_state', '') NOT IN ('ready_for_review', 'pm_l3_package_drafted', 'github_execution_retry_wait') THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'workflow_run_state_not_ready_for_github_execution', 'field', 'current_state', 'message', 'workflow_run current_state is not ready_for_review/pm_l3_package_drafted/github_execution_retry_wait', 'current_state', run_json->>'current_state'))
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb
    END AS errors
  FROM decision
)
SELECT
  http_status_code,
  (http_status_code = 200) AS should_persist,
  CASE WHEN http_status_code = 200 THEN 'persist' ELSE 'respond_error' END AS route,
  p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id,
  p->>'request_id' AS request_id,
  p->>'repository_full_name' AS repository_full_name,
  p->>'base_branch' AS base_branch,
  p->>'base_sha' AS base_sha,
  p->>'feature_branch' AS feature_branch,
  (SELECT w::text FROM wrapper) AS pg_parameter_string,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'workflow_name', 'MOEX_ROUTE_B_GITHUB_EXECUTION_REQUEST_INTAKE_V1_10_3',
    'spec_version', '1.10.3',
    'http_status_code', http_status_code,
    'accepted', false,
    'github_request_valid', request_valid,
    'workflow_run_id', p->>'workflow_run_id',
    'request_id', p->>'request_id',
    'repository_full_name', p->>'repository_full_name',
    'base_branch', p->>'base_branch',
    'base_sha', p->>'base_sha',
    'feature_branch', p->>'feature_branch',
    'status', CASE WHEN http_status_code = 404 THEN 'not_found' WHEN http_status_code = 409 THEN 'not_ready' ELSE 'invalid_request' END,
    'current_state', NULL,
    'current_phase', NULL,
    'event_type', NULL,
    'event_ref', NULL,
    'authority_boundary', COALESCE(p->'authority_boundary', '{}'::jsonb),
    'errors', errors
  ) AS response
FROM response_errors;

WITH wrapper AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS w
),
payload AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode(w->>'b64', 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS p
  FROM wrapper
),
prepared AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id,
    p->>'request_id' AS request_id,
    p->>'repository_full_name' AS repository_full_name,
    p->>'base_branch' AS base_branch,
    p->>'base_sha' AS base_sha,
    p->>'feature_branch' AS feature_branch,
    p->'event_payload_json' AS event_payload_json,
    md5(p::text) AS input_hash
  FROM payload
),
prior AS (
  SELECT
    r.workflow_run_id,
    r.current_state AS previous_state
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  JOIN prepared pr ON r.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
),
event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (
    workflow_run_id,
    previous_state,
    new_state,
    event_type,
    event_payload_json,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    pr.workflow_run_id,
    prior.previous_state,
    'github_execution_requested',
    'github_execution_requested',
    pr.event_payload_json,
    now()
  FROM prepared pr
  JOIN prior ON prior.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
  RETURNING event_id::text AS event_id,
            workflow_run_id,
            ('postgres://moex_n8n_workflow_run_events/' || event_id::text) AS event_ref
),
run_update AS (
  UPDATE moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  SET
    status = 'github_execution_requested',
    current_state = 'github_execution_requested',
    current_phase = 'github_branch_pr_executor_requested',
    target_branch_name = pr.feature_branch,
    error_message = NULL,
    locked_by = NULL,
    worker_execution_id = NULL,
    claim_token = NULL,
    lock_expires_at = NULL,
    last_heartbeat_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM prepared pr
  JOIN event_insert ev ON ev.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
  WHERE r.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
  RETURNING r.workflow_run_id
),
step_hashes AS (
  SELECT
    pr.workflow_run_id,
    pr.input_hash,
    md5((pr.p || jsonb_build_object('event_ref', ev.event_ref, 'status', 'github_execution_requested', 'current_state', 'github_execution_requested'))::text) AS output_hash
  FROM prepared pr
  JOIN event_insert ev ON ev.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
),
step_update AS (
  UPDATE moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs s
  SET
    status = 'completed',
    input_hash = sh.input_hash,
    output_hash = sh.output_hash,
    completed_at = now(),
    updated_at = now(),
    error_message = NULL
  FROM step_hashes sh
  WHERE s.workflow_run_id = sh.workflow_run_id
    AND s.step_name = 'github_execution_request_intake'
  RETURNING s.workflow_run_id
),
step_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs (
    workflow_run_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    attempt,
    input_hash,
    output_hash,
    started_at,
    completed_at,
    error_message,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    sh.workflow_run_id,
    'github_execution_request_intake',
    'completed',
    1,
    sh.input_hash,
    sh.output_hash,
    now(),
    now(),
    NULL,
    now(),
    now()
  FROM step_hashes sh
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM step_update su WHERE su.workflow_run_id = sh.workflow_run_id)
  RETURNING workflow_run_id
)
SELECT
  202 AS http_status_code,
  true AS accepted,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'workflow_name', 'MOEX_ROUTE_B_GITHUB_EXECUTION_REQUEST_INTAKE_V1_10_3',
    'spec_version', '1.10.3',
    'http_status_code', 202,
    'accepted', true,
    'github_request_valid', true,
    'workflow_run_id', pr.workflow_run_id,
    'request_id', pr.request_id,
    'repository_full_name', pr.repository_full_name,
    'base_branch', pr.base_branch,
    'base_sha', pr.base_sha,
    'feature_branch', pr.feature_branch,
    'status', 'github_execution_requested',
    'current_state', 'github_execution_requested',
    'current_phase', 'github_branch_pr_executor_requested',
    'event_type', 'github_execution_requested',
    'event_ref', ev.event_ref,
    'authority_boundary', COALESCE(pr.p->'authority_boundary', '{}'::jsonb),
    'errors', '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS response
FROM prepared pr
JOIN event_insert ev ON ev.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
JOIN run_update ru ON ru.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id;
